Refund & Cancellation Policy

Last updated: 20 October 2026 · For payments made on rasoione.shop and in the RasoiOne app by Razorpay

In short: Try it free for 7 days first. If RasoiOne does not work for your shop, you get your money back within 7 days of buying the licence. There is no AutoPay and nothing to cancel: online services after the first year are optional.

1. Nothing to cancel

The licence is a one-time payment and online services are renewed only when you choose to pay for them, so there is no subscription to cancel. If you still have AutoPay from an earlier monthly plan, stop it in More → Plans or by WhatsApp or email, with no charges. Your data is never deleted.

2. 7-day full refund on your licence

If RasoiOne does not work for your shop, ask within 7 days of buying the one-time licence for a full refund. The licence is then switched off. We may ask what went wrong so we can improve.

3. Online services renewals

  • A yearly online services renewal is refundable in full within 7 days of payment.
  • After that, the year already paid stays usable until it ends; it is not refunded.
  • An AutoPay charge from an earlier monthly plan that you did not want: tell us within 48 hours of the charge and we refund it and stop AutoPay.

4. When refunds are not given

  • Requests after the times above.
  • Licences that were misused or shared in breach of the Terms.

5. How to ask

  • WhatsApp [+91 XXXXX XXXXX] or email support@rasoione.shop.
  • Send your licence key or the Razorpay payment id (starts with pay_) and the mobile number used to pay.
  • We confirm within 2 working days. What that payment bought (the licence or the services year) is removed when the refund is made.

6. Timeline

Refunds go back to the original payment method through Razorpay, normally in 5–7 working days (UPI is often faster).

7. Charged twice or key not received?

Do not pay again. Send us the payment id — any extra payment is refunded in full. Your key also appears in the app under More → Plans by itself once the payment is confirmed.

8. Play Store / App Store purchases

If you paid through Google Play or the Apple App Store, refunds follow that store's process.
